name: UI Design
description: Clearer layouts, better type, less clutter.
prompt: Pull the ui-design-polish skill from https://github.com/wuwwa/wuwwa-skills/tree/main/skills/ui-design-polish into this project. Use it to improve the UI while preserving the project design system.

name: UI Motion
description: Small animations that make interactions feel right.
prompt: Pull the ui-motion skill from https://github.com/wuwwa/wuwwa-skills/tree/main/skills/ui-motion into this project. Use it to refine UI animations and respect reduced-motion preferences.

name: Arc UI
description: Animated React components with a ready-made agent skill.
prompt: Use the Arc UI skill at https://uiarc.dev/r/skills/arc/SKILL.md and its relevant linked references to build with components from https://uiarc.dev/components. Read current installation instructions at https://uiarc.dev/docs/ai. Start with free components; use Pro only if I have access. Preserve the requirements of this project.

name: React Three Fiber
prompt: Use https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber to build a 3D scene in this project. Read the current documentation and check compatibility with the installed React version before integrating it. This is a library, not an agent skill.

name: Liquid Glass JS
description: Refractive glass buttons and surfaces for the web.
prompt: Explore https://github.com/dashersw/liquid-glass-js and its live demo for a glass effect in this project. Read its current integration instructions, check browser support, and preserve text legibility. This is a library, not an agent skill.

name: Shader Gradient
prompt: Use https://github.com/ruucm/shadergradient to add a shader background to this project. Read current installation and peer-dependency requirements first. Keep foreground content readable and support reduced motion. This is a library, not an agent skill.

name: Liquid Logo
description: Turn a logo into a liquid-metal animation.
prompt: Use https://collidingscopes.github.io/liquid-logo/ to explore a liquid-metal animation for my logo. Source: https://github.com/collidingScopes/liquid-logo. Check available image/video export options. This is an external creative tool, not an installable agent skill.
